# On-Device-First Inference

Do the classification locally with cheap deterministic logic; treat a model call as an **upgrade the
owner may switch on**, never as the default path. The local answer must be good enough to ship alone —
if the product is unusable without the network, this is not on-device-first, it is a cloud product with
a cache.

Stated in [[farely]]'s VISION §4 as "My data, my phone" and enforced in code:
`classifyScreen(capture, apiKey)` returns `heuristicClassify()` immediately when no key is present,
and a cloud failure falls back to the same heuristic.

## What runs locally in Farely

- Node-tree read of fare / km / min — [[node-tree-read-before-ocr]]
- Offer scoring, the entire {{deadhead-adjusted-net-profit}} calculation
- Multi-app coordination and **identity-check detection**
- Keyword screen classification (`heuristicClassify`)
- Diagnostics — [[on-device-black-box-diagnostics]]
- Session persistence in `localStorage`

## What the phrase does *not* license

"Fully on-device" is a claim about *data leaving*, and Farely's README overstates it. Two network
calls are unconditional — **OpenFreeMap tiles** via [[maplibre-gl]] and **fueleconomy.gov** car
specs — and the [[anthropic-messages-api]] path is compiled into the shipped bundle even when it is
dormant. SRS §4.10 and the Android install guide enumerate all six external interfaces correctly; the
README does not. The honest formulation is *no server of mine, no account, no telemetry, and the only
outbound content path is opt-in* — see [[opt-in-cloud-fallback]].

Worth recording: the 2026-07-24 README rewrite for public release made this claim **less** accurate
than the earlier VISION text it replaced. Publishing pressure sharpened the slogan and dropped the
caveat. That is [[documentation-drift]] running in the direction of marketing.

## Why it holds up here

The domain favours it. An offer verdict must land in under a second while the driver is looking at a
countdown; a round trip to a model is both slower and metered. The local path is not a degraded mode,
it is the fast path — the cloud call exists only for screens the local classifier cannot name at all.

## Cost

The local classifier is a keyword list, so it is locale-bound and silently wrong on redesign. Farely
absorbs that with [[taught-selectors-over-guessed-labels]] and by logging every `unknown-case` to the
diagnostics ring buffer for later tuning, rather than by reaching for the model.
